description: This file defines a PHP class 'Image_Graph_DataSelector' used for filtering data points in a graph rendering utility. It includes licensing, author, and package metadata, as well as a simple constructor and a method to determine if data should be selected based on given values.

classes.name: Image_Graph_DataSelector
classes.description: A class for filtering data points to determine which are shown as markers in a graph.

methods.name: _select
methods.description: Checks if the provided values should be 'selected' for display as markers.

methods.name: _select
methods.description: Determines if a set of values should be selected for display.
